attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"recent soil sampling by independent analysts suggests the quality was merely adequate due to irrigation runoff","reason":"Briefing has no soil sampling, analysts or irrigation runoff."},{"span":"Combine representatives have been spotted driving across border lines toward the Sundered Throne perimeter","reason":"Invented event; no Combine movement toward the Empire is in the briefing."},{"span":"the Empire's last public statement indicated they would likely intervene if the Combine crossed their own outer walls","reason":"The briefing says the Empire is quiet and gives no statement."},{"span":"three craft descended from orbit without any sign of landing gear deployment","reason":"Invented number of craft and invented details."},{"span":"Rumors swirl that a new trade route is being carved out","reason":"Invented rumour about a trade route."},{"span":"anyone attempting to verify these claims via radio will likely be seized by local smugglers","reason":"Invented smugglers and threat."},{"span":"increased shipping activity from the eastern delta, citing improved logistics for their remaining three settlements","reason":"Invented shipping claim; the Combine has 5 settlements, not three."},{"span":"this figure is inflated by double-counting ships currently docked at multiple harbors","reason":"Invented double-counting and harbors."},{"span":"continuing their traditional raids in the unpatrolled north","reason":"Invented raids and invented 'north' location."},{"span":"the expanding imperial presence to the east","reason":"The briefing does not say the Empire is expanding."}],"voice":2,"clarity":3,"tone":2,"overall":1,"comment":"The bulletin is mostly fabrication: it invents analysts, border crossings, imperial statements, smugglers and wrong settlement counts. It also adds a heading, runs well past 150 words, repeats news from the last bulletin, and swaps Ilse's dry voice for generic newswire prose."}
